mission: D9 F1 rule (owner decision 2026-10-17 15:41Z): in the shared source-mapping resolver, a Yuyu-Tei listing whose release has exactly one listing of its kind (plain, parallel, foil) and exactly one eligible print of that kind resolves to that print as an exact PROPOSAL. Foil listings (ラメフォイル, 海賊旗フォイル) are their own kind and match only a foil print, else stay unmatched. Proposals only: nothing is approved, mapped or priced by this change; going live is a later owner-approved ops-write batch of about 500 with a 48 h storage check. The yuyutei collector imports the resolver, so its nine shards are redeployed one at a time; snkrdunk is untouched. Identity-capture batches stay paused.

impacts.reason: Shared resolver, collector runtime input for yuyutei only (import graph). New branch before the ambiguous result, Yuyu-Tei only, when more than one print is eligible: listing kind from title and rarity token, print kind from treatment and variant; exact only when the release holds exactly this one listing of the kind (all Yuyu-Tei candidates, slug or published label), exactly one same-kind print, every sibling kind known, and the print is not approved for another listing. Adds unique_listing_kind_match to the payload, so only matched listings get a new digest; RESOLVER_VERSION unchanged. Status exact means a pending proposal; approval still goes through the existing reviewed path and re-runs the resolver. No identity guard is removed; every other branch is byte-identical.

Base and parallel resolve both ways; a second same-kind listing reverts to ambiguous on refresh; labelled listings on another category count; two parallel prints with one listing stay ambiguous; foil matches only a foil print; plain never selects a foil print; a print approved elsewhere is never selected; an unknown sibling kind blocks the rule; approval revalidation keeps the same digest.

resources.name: Staging Postgres (no migration; proposal rows written by ordinary discovery turns)

dependencies: resolver 1.3 (PR #103 rollout, receipt a504e476); D9 sizing PR #156, #166, #169
impact.deployment_impact: Nine yuyutei collector shards redeployed sequentially by deploy_staging_collectors (refuses to start 02:00-06:00 UTC, restores newest-first on failure). snkrdunk-collector not in collector_services. No raw_dependency_migration, no DDL, no variable, schedule, budget or pacing change.

recovery.procedure: Automatic during rollout: every touched shard restored newest-first to its recovery_deployment_id (the PR #103 a504e476 images, matched by fleet-vs-receipt 10/10 at 2026-10-17 15:53Z). After delivery: native revert PR of this change, delivered the same way; proposals written by the rule stay as pending history and the old code re-versions those listings back to ambiguous. Nothing is approved by this change, so no mapping or price needs undoing.
recovery.trigger: Any drop in approved exact or approved-with-proof counts versus pre-release staging-state; any stored proposal differs RuntimeError; any discovery failure; any 403/429/challenge; deployment failure; schedule or flag drift; more new proposal versions on the first full discovery cycle than about 1,000 (775 prints expected, MEASURED sizing run 39076525684).
recovery.backup: No schema change. Railway Postgres daily backups continue; no row is rewritten, only new proposal versions appended.

verification.observation_window: Delivery artifact plus one completed natural discovery turn per Yuyu shard on the new code. Then: approved exact and approved-with-proof unchanged; new exact pending proposals about 775 with reason unique_listing_kind_resolves_one_release_sibling; 0 stored-proposal-differs errors; 0 discovery failures; lossless green; storage-rates 48 h after release.

operational_notes: Identity-capture batches are PAUSED from 2026-10-17 15:41Z (owner decision) until the F1 batches are live: no new capture work is enqueued (no enqueue-remaining-50 or yuyu_identity_capture_enqueue apply). Already-queued intents may finish. The snkrdunk and yuyutei collector services are not stopped, redeployed or changed.
While paused, D9 F2 (about 220 prints waiting on capture intents or captures not yet enqueued) stalls: prints whose intents are already queued may still complete, nothing new is added.
